testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and show a solid using the active view commands: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1179:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and show a solid using the active view commands ✔ Given The MCAD Software has a part containing one solid body ✔ And a copied view is active ✔ And the solid body is visible ✔ When the user chooses All Hidden from the active view context menu ✔ Then the solid body is not displayed in the viewport ✔ And the solid body and its extrusion remain in the model browser ✔ When the user chooses All Visible from the active view context menu ✔ Then the solid body is displayed in the viewport ✔ And the solid body and its extrusion remain in the model browser
